items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I formed a band with Red Callender, Bumps Myers, Paul Campbell Gamel was trumpet

ctx.x: religious, too. He used to -- in those days, he used to always have his Bible. This was in '40 and '41, you know, and everybody would be on the bus and the train or wherever they would be -- and he would be over in the corner reading his Bible, you know.

But he was a nice man -- very, very nice man. And he looked out for me. Just as I told you like Ethel Waters did? Looked out for me, you know. I lived where he and Gladys lived ... always. So that's just growing pains, I guess, but after Hamp, oh yes -- after Hamp, I came back home, and I formed a band with Red Callender, Bumps Myers, Paul Campbell Gamel was trumpet -- Louis Gonzales on guitar. And Arthur Twine was playing piano.

And we used to rehearse 5 days a week, and then Lester quit Basie, and we were working at a place called Billy Billie Berg's, but, see, Billy Berg's had 4 or 5 places in Los Angeles, and in '42, Billy Bergs was at La Cienega and Pico, where the bank is now; where the movie house is, at La Cienega and Pico; that's where Billy Berg's was. And ...
